description: Two-valued null logic + cross-type ORDER BY (SCHEMA.md §5). t.a = 5 is FALSE when a is explicitly null (n2) or missing ≡ null (n3), true for n1 and n4. Projecting t.b then ordering mixes int (n4, rank 2) and text (n1, rank 3): the int sorts first under the single total order.
query: MATCH (t:T) WHERE t.a = 5 RETURN t.b ORDER BY t.b
